protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: In 2.630, mailboxes/folders-lib.pl View/Open links route regular attachments to detach.cgi without a type override. mailboxes/detach.cgi copies the attachment MIME type into Content-Type and emits non-text/html bytes unfiltered, so a hostile image/svg+xml attachment is rendered as a script-capable document on the Webmin origin. CVE.org state is PUBLISHED and marks versions before 2.640 affected; the vendor security page describes the same Read User Mail SVG-attachment XSS.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: 27d3d6cb9738150bc944ae17ebe8fc8a6396012e is the smallest surviving public first-write of the vulnerable Content-Type passthrough and non-HTML raw-body path. The full, non-shallow clone's all-ref add history identifies only this commit for mailboxes/detach.cgi; f6788682b34ba6adf61fd0d749935afb58c15451 is rejected because its parent already contains the sink.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: git rev-list --parents -n 1 returns only 27d3d6cb9738150bc944ae17ebe8fc8a6396012e, git cat-file -p contains no parent header, and git diff-tree --root records mailboxes/detach.cgi as added.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: CONFIRMED_NOT_APPLICABLE: The BIC is the repository's parentless public root first-write, not a move, refactor, revert, or later squash aggregate. With no parent and no earlier all-ref file-add object in the full clone, no finer public member can be reconstructed.
protocol_checks.release_membership: CONFIRMED: 27d3d6cb9738150bc944ae17ebe8fc8a6396012e is an ancestor of tags 2.630 and 2.640. Fix cf432879a14568c4bb44cd2f9e5a9bd0e168edc1 is not an ancestor of 2.630 but is an ancestor of 2.640; it is the only mailboxes/detach.cgi commit in 2.630..2.640. Tag 2.630 still contains the vulnerable MIME passthrough.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: CONFIRMED_DIRECT_FIX: cf432879a14568c4bb44cd2f9e5a9bd0e168edc1 directly detects SVG by attachment MIME type, requested type, or .svg/.svgz filename and serves it as text/plain. CVE.org and GHSA both reference that commit, and the 2.640 changelog records unsafe mailbox attachment handling as fixed. Later b14f24fc61859fdc26772f04cc36b7af1e00c8cd adds broader script-type filtering but does not negate the direct SVG Content-Type fix.
